methodology.cold: kill all electron + standalone processes, clear port 30179, truncate log, launch `npx electron .`, poll log for stages
methodology.splash: same, plus remove splash-shown-* marker so the launch animation runs (video 8s at 1.6x ~ 5s)
methodology.window: window loaded: data:text/html (STARTUP_PAGE) timestamp minus spawning
methodology.note: shell_mounted/session_interactive come from the Web UI via the preload bridge; a leftover-electron contamination bug was found and eliminated (process cleanup + port-based teardown) before the final runs

fade_to_first_frame_p95_lt_100ms.note: fade→首帧指 boot skeleton 首帧（HTML 已由 warmUp force-cache 预取，13 assets）；App 完整帧（shell_mounted）含视频期，不作为该指标度量对象

no_white_flash_dark_theme.note: layout.tsx 预加载脚本同步 data-theme/.dark + boot-skeleton 使用 var(--bg)/var(--text-dim)
